text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The third year's "Summer Training Camp" 
with Narita Taishin has begun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who spent last year's 
training camp with her came by to invite 
her out to train and hang out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seems a bit bewildered, 
though not entirely averse to it—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this year's Summer Camp is 
going to be a lot of fun.
